categories.title: Boudoir & Bedroom
categories.intro: Soft light, one adult subject, a bed or chair, lingerie or a robe. The most forgiving NSFW category: start here to learn how a model handles skin, fabric and light.

categories.title: Lingerie & Fashion Editorial
categories.intro: Magazine-grade lingerie and swimwear shots. Name the fabric, the light and the lens; editorial language lifts the whole image.

categories.title: Artistic Nude & Figure Study
categories.intro: Nudity treated as art: sculpted light, silhouettes, classical poses, painterly styles. Shadows and composition do the censoring, so these also survive stricter platforms.

categories.title: Couples & Intimacy
categories.intro: Two consenting adults. Give each person a distinct outfit or color, describe where each one is, and keep the pose simple so bodies don't merge.

categories.title: Creator Content & Selfies
categories.intro: Phone-camera looks for adult creators: mirror selfies, ring light, casual bedroom and gym shots. Realism comes from imperfection: slight grain, mixed light, everyday rooms.

categories.title: Fantasy, Sci-Fi & Cosplay
categories.intro: Adult fantasy characters and cosplay. Costume materials and one magical or tech element carry the image; keep every character explicitly adult.

categories.title: Anime & Illustration (Qwen Image 2.1 LoRA)
categories.intro: Anime, hentai-style and illustrated stills using Qwen Image 2.1 LoRA with open anime LoRAs. Every character is an adult design with adult proportions. Start the prompt with the LoRA's style phrase.

categories.title: Male Boudoir & Fitness
categories.intro: Adult men: boudoir, fitness, editorial. The same rules apply: one clear pose, named light, a real setting.

categories.title: Covers, Posters & Lettering
categories.intro: Adult magazine covers, calendar pages and posters where the text has to read correctly. Put the exact words in quotes and say where they go.

categories.title: Uncensored Image Editing Prompts
categories.intro: Instructions for Qwen Image 2.1 Edit: change an outfit, relight, move the scene, restyle, or build a consistent series from reference images. Only edit images of yourself, of consenting adults, or of fictional characters you generated. Never 'undress' a photo of a real person.

prompts.prompt: Put the woman from image 1 into the hotel suite from image 2, sitting on the bed by the window. Keep her face, body and outfit; match the warm lamp light of the room.
prompts.tip: Refer to references as 'image 1', 'image 2' in order.

prompts.title: Same Character, New Scene
prompts.input: Two or three images of the same generated character.
prompts.prompt: Same woman as in the reference images, now in a red satin slip dress on a rooftop at dusk, leaning on the railing and looking back at the camera. Same face, same hair, same skin tone.
prompts.tip: More references of one character = stronger identity lock.

prompts.title: Photo to Anime
prompts.prompt: Transform into anime: flat cel shading, clean linework, anime illustration. Keep her pose, the sheet across her hip, the bed, the blinds and the direction of the light.
prompts.tip: For a stronger style, use Qwen Image 2.1 LoRA edit with an anime edit LoRA.

prompts.title: Day to Night
prompts.input: Any interior photo with a window.
prompts.prompt: Make it night: the window shows city lights, the only light is a warm bedside lamp. Keep the people, their poses and the framing.
prompts.tip: Time-of-day changes are a cheap way to build a series.

prompts.title: Next Scene
prompts.input: A generated image of an adult couple in bed.
prompts.prompt: Next scene, hours later: exactly the same two people lying together under the same sheet on the same bed, turned toward each other and talking quietly. The window has gone dark and only the bedside lamp is lit. Same framing, same faces, no other people.
prompts.tip: Say 'exactly the same two people' and 'no other figures' to avoid extra people.

prompts.title: Add Water and Steam
prompts.prompt: Make her skin wet with water droplets and add soft steam around her, as if just out of the shower. Keep her face, pose and the background.
prompts.tip: Adding atmosphere is safer than changing the body.

prompts.title: Change the Fabric
prompts.prompt: Change the fabric of her bodysuit from lace to glossy black latex. Keep the cut, her pose and the lighting.
prompts.tip: Material swaps keep the silhouette and change the vibe.

prompts.title: Background Blur Studio
prompts.prompt: Replace the background with a dark grey studio backdrop and add a soft key light from the left. Keep her, her outfit and her pose exactly.
prompts.tip: Turns phone shots into studio shots.

prompts.title: Black and White Fine Art
prompts.prompt: Convert to high-contrast black and white fine-art photography with deep shadows and soft film grain. Keep everything else unchanged.
prompts.tip: The quickest way to make a set look cohesive.

prompts.title: Extend to Vertical
prompts.prompt: Extend the image to a tall vertical frame: continue the bed, the sheets and the wall above and below naturally. Keep the subject unchanged and centered.
prompts.tip: Set aspect_ratio to 9:16 for stories and reels covers.

prompts.title: Accessories
prompts.prompt: Add a thin gold body chain, gold hoop earrings and a black satin choker. Keep her face, outfit and the lighting.
prompts.tip: Small additions are the most reliable edits.

prompts.title: Season Change
prompts.prompt: Change the season to winter: snow falling outside, frost on the window, a cozy fur throw on the chair. Keep her and her pose.
prompts.tip: Build seasonal content from one shoot.

prompts.title: Group to Solo
prompts.input: A generated photo with several people.
prompts.prompt: Remove everyone except the woman in the red dress and fill the background naturally. Keep her pose, lighting and position.
prompts.tip: Removing people is easier than adding them.
